activate.description: Ordered case-insensitive effect substring selects the name at match+7; last occurrence wins. Any whole FALSE token latches disabled and TRUE does not undo it. Apply emitter state and saved disabled-name mutation in that order, even if no emitter matches.

set.description: Read current-world bank, find existing emitter, then enable or disable the found index.

find.description: Null name returns -1. Skip reserved table index0; first matching name in requested loaded bank wins. If absent, first table match in loaded bank0 or1 wins. Signed count and null table entries preserved.

enable.description: Index -1 no-op, otherwise write activation byte+2f=2. Direct index0 is valid.

disable.description: Index -1 no-op, otherwise write activation byte+2f=0.

save.description: Twelve16-byte disabled-name slots at record+2d68. Null record/name or name length>=16 returns0. First case-insensitive match: enabling clears only first byte and returns2; disabling returns3. Missing enabled name returns0. Missing disabled name copies into first empty slot and returns1, or returns1 without write when full. Preserve slot tail bytes.

commands.name: ActivateEffect
commands.qualification: Existing emitter bank/state and saved disabled-name list; particle allocation and simulation remain external.

native.method: Original GIT handler, current-world getter, emitter bank lookup, enable/disable byte stores and saved-name mutation all execute unchanged with no substitutions. Complete emitter/save/table/world memory regions compared.

limits: Valid finite emitter pointer table with reserved index0 and readable loaded-bank flags. Existing emitters only; no allocation or particle simulation recovered.
Terminated ASCII names/12 fixed16-byte save slots; substring effect must leave its delimiter-skip pointer within the source token.
Managed replay pending; emitter-state consumption and save lifecycle remain separate.
